cookieConsent.title: Cookie settings
cookieConsent.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to ensure that the website works properly and, with your consent, to enable additional features. Necessary cookies are always used. Optional cookies (analytics, marketing, and external media) are used only after you give your consent. You can accept all, reject optional cookies, or adjust your settings.
cookieConsent.necessaryDescription: Required for basic website operation. Always active.
cookieConsent.analyticsDescription: Help us understand how the website is used (for example, Google Analytics).
cookieConsent.marketingDescription: Used for advertising and marketing measurement when you consent.
cookieConsent.externalMediaDescription: Allow loading external content (for example, embedded media) only after consent.
